main: Clean merge of ODS hyperlinks, outline groups, metadata documentation, and filter predicates (PR59-62).
zotero: Independent source identity, shared backoff, dialog scan caching, five test files, and standalone hyphenation license/generator notice cleanup applied without overwriting local changes.
proofing: Read comments before applying styles; include comments in both style traversals.
Exclude generated page-number paragraphs, including empty ones; bind cached and pending results to this metadata.
Restore active caret and full selection during correction undo/redo.
Check a replacement dialog controller and ignore old-controller asynchronous completions.
Use half-open nonempty issue hit ranges and exact zero-width insertion points.
Adopt strict analyzer fixes for engine exports and Zotero test fixtures.
Treat noProof as an absolute XML on/off value, so an explicit empty element overrides inherited false.
Exclude closed and spanning empty complex-field paragraphs, retaining zero-width guards and coverage accounting.
Bind correction caret restoration to comment/header/footer story identity; preserve unrelated-story selection on undo/redo.
semantic_resolution: Continuation session/controller/renderer APIs and additional protection, grapheme, pending-revision, real-renderer and stale-document regressions retained; overlapping alternative proofing implementations and their receipts remain accessible through merge ancestry.
concurrent_writer_boundary: This is an explicit timestamped snapshot, not a claim that remote writers have stopped.
